Another modern author, not fatisified with any hypothesis hitherto advanced, affigns the fun to be the local hell. The chief objection to the eternity of hell torments among modern writers, is the dilproportion between temporary crimes and eternal punifhments. HELM _of a fhip_, is a piece of timber fattened into the

or _right the helm_; that is, keep it even with the
middle of the hip. _Port the helm_, put it over the
the left fide of the fhip. _Starboard the helm_, put it
on the right fide of the fhip.
